study_unit_instruction: Distinct independent evolution populations, selected clones, laboratory reactions, guided genetic-search model rounds, assayed sequences, and reanalyses cannot be pooled.

studies.units: 12 independent full selection lines, two switch origins; 3/36 vs 0/138 one-round replay separately
studies.positive: necessary/sufficient metabolic mutation in potentiated ancestor causes switch; fitness history changes sign
studies.negative: special novelty-exclusion/bottleneck required for persistence, without them evolved switch loses fitness; phenotype possible in original background but deleterious

studies.units: engineered two rate configurations in selected environmental schedules, not natural evolution origins
studies.positive: fast/slow switch strategy winner depends on researcher-chosen environmental duration
studies.negative: all two-state gene regulation, rates and fitness environment installed by experimenters

studies.units: two earlier diverse lines A/B, one undiversified WT comparison, 8 new-substrate selection generations
studies.positive: ~8x/~6x faster rate at generation five; independently inactive ribozyme recovered function with helper
studies.negative: external mutagenesis, copying and selection, helper rescue not independently reproducing multi-component life

studies.units: eight original evolving populations each environmental condition, 2 representatives chosen per condition; assay universe 52 formerly inaccessible types
studies.positive: higher mutation supply did not improve novelty count, more complex selection environment correlated with more novel viability
studies.negative: complex environments got ~600 vs ~100–200 generations, only one five-factor complex environment; gene/pleiotropy causation mostly inferred

studies.units: >120000 assayed molecules and all 65536 intermediates of a 16-site candidate pair, not independent evolving lineages
studies.positive: neutral network paths connect distant functional RNA genotype configurations under assay threshold
studies.negative: MLP trained to guide candidate selection, 100 in-silico evolutionary steps, external activity threshold and RNA chemistry

studies.units: 88 independent evolving samples from 12 founding genetic lineages across five selected adversity proportions
studies.positive: dormancy evolved according to adverse-frequency and geometric-mean fitness interpretation
studies.negative: no two consecutive adverse years allowed; many extinct lineages, not proven genotypic mechanism or spontaneous new dormancy

studies.type: protein cryptic genotypic diversity / laboratory directed evolution
studies.positive: hidden variation changes which color-functional peaks reachable under selected tests
studies.negative: chosen fluorescent phenotype and lab mutation guided, entire primary methods not audited

studies.type: research synthesis of promiscuous enzyme functions
studies.positive: side activities furnish physical capability reserve, median 31 M^-1s^-1 across 108 enzymes
studies.negative: many side activities below actual cellular throughput usefulness, not an independent new wetlab cohort
